== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Rebel Tech]]. Columns cover distinct published text states, in date order; the stamp row describes the displayed rendition. Japanese and Virtual printings remain in Versions; a Revised, Unlimited or foil reprint whose printed words differ is a column. Yellow highlights mark changed words against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[Rebel Tech (Revised)]] has its own column (September 1998).
